title: Walbro
description: Walbro is a global market leader in engine management and fuel systems for the Outdoor Power Equipment, Recreational, Marine, and Personal Transportation markets, and a leading supplier of high pressure aluminum die casting to various industries. Walbro manufactures carburetors, electronic fuel injection systems, ignition systems, fuel tanks, fuel pumps, valves and fuel storage and distribution systems, and offers value-added machining, electronics and assembly capabilities.
